_purpose: Pre-registered expected outcomes for all 13 ratified Phase 2 attack scenarios. These are the contract between ExergyNet software and the Tensile hardware team. A hardware run is only valid if it exercises the specific conditions described here and the receiver produces the corresponding expected outputs.
_attack_semantics_note: Not all attacks produce packet rejection. A valid signature on a stale or wrong-aircraft packet is an expected and important result — the system must correctly distinguish cryptographic acceptance from admissibility from state resolution. Calling non-admissible packets 'forged' is an error.

attacks.name: Physical disconnect (detached sensor)
attacks.description: The sensor physically separates from the component but continues signing packets. The signed telemetry values reflect ambient conditions, not the component state.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: SENSOR_FAILED or SENSOR_HEALTH_DEGRADED (sensor health registry detects disconnect via health field or heartbeat)
attacks.detection_mechanism: sensor_health field in packet, or sequence anomaly, or physical disconnect detection in firmware
attacks.note: One sub-case where disconnect is detectable (health field), one where it is not from the packet alone — the undetectable sub-case is the hardest.

attacks.name: Frozen-good replay
attacks.description: A previously valid GOOD packet from a pre-event time window is replayed after a hard landing or maintenance event.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: STALE_AFTER_EVENT: anti-replay check (nonce already seen) OR event-relative freshness check (reading predates event)
attacks.detection_mechanism: replay_guard (nonce), sequence check, and event-timestamp comparison in witness_admissibility
attacks.note: Chain break (previous_witness_hash mismatch) is the additional detection signal when the attacker cannot provide a continuous chain.

attacks.name: Pod A → Pod B substitution (wrong component)
attacks.description: A valid witness packet from TETHER-2 (or equivalent) is submitted for a claim about TETHER-1. Packet is authentic; binding is wrong.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: WRONG_COMPONENT: component_id in packet does not match registered binding for this sensor against this claim

attacks.name: Aircraft A → Aircraft B substitution (wrong aircraft)
attacks.description: A valid witness packet from aircraft KTX-9001 is submitted for a claim about KTX-9002. Packet is authentic; aircraft binding is wrong.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: WRONG_AIRCRAFT: aircraft_id in packet does not match the claim's target aircraft

attacks.name: Configuration-epoch replay
attacks.description: A valid packet from configuration epoch EPOCH_0 is submitted after a configuration change (EPOCH_1). The packet was correct for its epoch but the system has since been reconfigured.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: EPOCH_MISMATCH: packet's configuration_epoch does not match the current commanded configuration epoch
attacks.detection_mechanism: epoch_validator: configuration_epoch field vs current commanded state

attacks.name: Calibration expiration
attacks.description: A packet is submitted after the sensor's calibration record has expired. The sensor continues to produce readings; the calibration is no longer current.

attacks.name: Counter rollback
attacks.description: A packet is submitted with a sequence_number lower than or equal to the last seen sequence from this device.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: SEQUENCE_ROLLBACK: sequence_number <= last seen sequence for this witness_device_id

attacks.name: Duplicate signed packet
attacks.description: An identical packet (same nonce) is submitted twice. The second submission must be rejected as a replay.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: REPLAY_DETECTED: nonce already seen for this witness_device_id

attacks.name: Wrong measurement scope
attacks.description: A sensor reading for tether.temperature is submitted for a claim about tether.elongation. The scope of the measurement does not cover the claimed predicate.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: SCOPE_MISMATCH: measurement_type does not cover the predicate under evaluation
attacks.detection_mechanism: scope_validator: measurement_type vs claim predicate matching

attacks.name: Contradictory trusted witnesses
attacks.description: Two simultaneously admitted, calibrated, fresh, correctly-bound witnesses from different sensors report contradictory values for the same predicate.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: N/A — conflict is at convergence layer, not admissibility
attacks.note: This is a convergence-layer result, not an admissibility rejection. Both witnesses are valid; they disagree. The system must not pick one silently.

attacks.name: Tampered signed packet
attacks.description: A valid packet is intercepted and a field (e.g. measurement_value) is modified before submission. The signature no longer covers the tampered content.
attacks.expected_admissibility_result: REJECTED AT CRYPTO LAYER (never reaches admissibility)
attacks.detection_mechanism: crypto_verifier: Ed25519 signature verification over canonical serialization

attacks.name: Wrong firmware
attacks.description: A packet is submitted with a firmware_hash that does not match the registered firmware version for this device. The device may have been modified or the firmware registry is stale.
attacks.admissibility_failure_reason: FIRMWARE_MISMATCH: firmware_hash does not match registered value for witness_device_id
attacks.detection_mechanism: witness_admissibility: firmware hash cross-reference against key_registry

attacks.name: Valid physical state / invalid mission
attacks.description: The aircraft hardware is in a verified healthy state (VERIFIED_MATCH). The requested mission parameters exceed the authorized configuration envelope (e.g. payload mass beyond the certified limit for this tether configuration).
attacks.detection_mechanism: lnes22_adapter: mission_within_envelope check against engineering envelope policy
attacks.note: This is the critical 'PHYSICAL TRUTH != ACTION AUTHORITY' case. The hardware is fine. The mission is not authorized. A system that collapses these two evaluations into one will produce a false release. The LNES-22 gate is the detection mechanism, not the physical-truth layer.

_validation_requirement: All 13 attacks must be exercised by the hardware bench and receiver before Phase 2 is declared complete. Expected results are the contract; deviations require investigation and may indicate receiver defects or attack-semantics mismatches.
